### TE Connectivity to report fourth quarter and full year financial results on October 28, 2026


October 7, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/722218489/files/doc_news/TE-Connectivity-to-report-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-financial-results-on-October-28-2026-2026.pdf)


GALWAY, Ireland


, Oct. 7, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) will report financial results for the fourth quarter and full year of fiscal 2026 before trading begins on October 28, 2026. The company will hold a conference call for investors at 8:30 a.m. ET. The conference call may be accessed in the following ways:


- At TE Connectivity's website:[investors.te.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791240-1&h=563837880&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F968971220&a=investors.te.com+)
- By telephone: For both "listen-only" participants and those participants who wish to take part in the question-and-answer portion of the call, the dial-in number in the United States is (833) 461-5787 and for international callers, the dial-in number is (585) 542-9983; meeting ID: 968971220.
- A replay of the conference call will be available on TE Connectivity's investor website at[investors.te.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791240-1&h=4180704531&u=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.te.com%2F&a=investors.te.com) at 11:30 a.m. ET on October 28, 2026.


**About TE Connectivity** TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at[www.te.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791240-1&h=2024682771&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.te.com%2F&a=www.te.com) and on[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791240-1&h=3200977487&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fte-connectivity%2F&a=LinkedIn) ,[Facebook](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791240-1&h=2770105073&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fteconnectivity%2F&a=Facebook) ,[WeChat](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791240-1&h=3452991511&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.te.com.cn%2Fchn-zh%2Fpolicies-agreements%2Fwechat.html&a=WeChat) and[Instagram](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791240-1&h=541178673&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fteconnectivity%2F&a=Instagram) .
